goal: Stop polluting debug logs with Tor connection failure warnings on nodes not configured to use Tor
Inform node operators when an established onion service connection is unexpectedly lost
agreement: Substantive support for cleaning up log spam without open objections
Verified by testing cleaner log output across macOS and Debian (pinheadmz, winterrdog)
Objections on preserving warnings for explicitly configured nodes resolved by updates (fjahr)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it suppresses a recurring 18 line per hour log noise regression on default nodes
It improves node operator visibility when an active onion service unexpectedly disconnects
It has no impact on P2P network reliability or transport behavior
